## Review checklist
- [ ] The change is focused and project-agnostic.
- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, private material, or unintended metadata are included.
- [ ] Dependencies, scripts, and workflows were reviewed where relevant.

- [ ] Claims about tests, scans, settings, and controls are supported by evidence.
